title: Evaluation of a circuit gate
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean circuit with $n$ input bits, let $x$ be an assignment of Boolean values to those inputs, and let $i$ be a gate position in $C$. The value of gate $i$ is obtained by reading the indicated input bit or constant, or by applying its negation, conjunction, or disjunction to the values of its earlier source gates.
